svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.monkey-forelimb-skeleton-model", "source_master_path": "tactile/masters/education/anatomy/skeletons/monkey-forelimb-skeleton-model.svg", "source_master_sha256": "51d5e67fbf73ec54ebfc50e83dbe844ee90247e646d8b521d4e90f5a04626742", "page_fit_revision": {"status": "regenerated", "method": "Explicit mathematical construction in millimetres; original physical strokes retained and Index dots freshly placed. No export scaling.", "simplification": "Meaning-specific reconstruction with original 1.4 mm strokes and freshly sampled 1.2 mm Index dots. Right rhesus monkey forelimb retains the source unequal-ended humerus, separate ulna on page-left, thumb-side radius on page-right, grouped wrist and five digital chains. Thumb has one short metacarpal and two phalanges; each other digit has one metacarpal and three phalanges. The proximal source bone contours are independently widened and shortened; the small hand bones become simple rounded capsules, joint gaps expanded, and the hand enlarged relative to the forearm. The wrist oval represents several carpals, not one biological bone. No equine forearm fusion or human eight-carpal convention is introduced. Relative lengths and joint-surface anatomy are not measurements.", "canvas_mm": [170, 200]}, "teaching": "Right rhesus monkey forelimb retains the source unequal-ended humerus, separate ulna on page-left, thumb-side radius on page-right, grouped wrist and five digital chains. Thumb has one short metacarpal and two phalanges; each other digit has one metacarpal and three phalanges. The proximal source bone contours are independently widened and shortened; the small hand bones become simple rounded capsules, joint gaps expanded, and the hand enlarged relative to the forearm. The wrist oval represents several carpals, not one biological bone. No equine forearm fusion or human eight-carpal convention is introduced. Relative lengths and joint-surface anatomy are not measurements. External object-name and viewpoint key required; physical tactile and learner evaluation remain pending.
